name: 终极地狱-轩辕传说
english_description: A stripped-down "base engine code" snapshot of the same Doing-Lu "hell" lineage already represented in this collection by hell/hellxg/zjmudhell -- adm/single/master.lpc carries the identical header chain ("for ES II mudlib / original from Lil / rewritten by Annihilator (11/07/94) / modified by Xiang for XKX (12/15/95) / updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K)"), and the login banner self-identifies as "EMPEROR OF ULTRA HELL(BLOOD & MAGIC) FROM 1999.12.12" with internet mud name "hell.local" and smtp sender doinglu@163.net -- the same author/codebase as hell's own "REVIVE OF ULTRA HELL...FROM 1999.11.13" banner, but an independently-diverged, much smaller GitHub release (1,901 files vs hell's 8,549) whose own repo description literally reads "mud 底层代码" ("MUD base/engine code"). Only 3 of the original ~54 city/sect domains ship in this archive (death, pk, register) -- the entire kungfu/skill/ tree, and the whole /d/city starting-town domain (including this archive's own hard-coded START_ROOM="/d/city/kedian"), are simply absent, a genuine pre-existing completeness gap in the upstream release rather than a conversion artifact. Porting fixed several real driver-incompatibility/robustness bugs on top of the well-known catalog entries shared with this lineage's other libs (log_error() never distinguishing warnings from errors at all -- worse than the miscapitalized-check variant found in zhyx/naruto, since this codebase's copy had no check whatsoever and broadcast every lazy-compile warning to whichever player triggered it; the classic GBK-byte-range is_chinese()/check_legal_name()/named.lpc "deep" length-halving family; command.lpc's command_hook wrongly declared private; the eventd/storyd/luban.lpc [0..<3]-vs-[0..<5] .lpc-rename-width bug; message()'s unconditional 4-arg efun::message() call; a get_config(__MUD_PORT__) (int)-cast-vs-to_int() bug in both versiond.lpc and the shared LOCAL_PORT() macro; a dns_master.lpc UDP read_callback declared to take a string when this driver delivers a BUFFER; and an accept_kill()->is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string) argument-type bug in clone/user/user.lpc, the exact same-lineage bug already catalogued for hell itself). Two bugs found nowhere else in this collection so far: virtuald.lpc's file_size(name+".lpc") existence check was truthy for -1 (file-not-found), turning any reference to genuinely-missing virtual-room content into infinite mutual recursion with master.lpc's compile_object() ("Inherit chain too deep: > 60") instead of a clean "no such object"; and clone/user/user.lpc's calc_sec_id() integrity-checksum hook shipped as a completely unimplemented placeholder (always returning the literal string "none", ignoring its own crypt-gating parameter) whose own round-trip check in restore() could therefore never pass, permanently locking every player out of their own previously-saved character the moment the driver was ever restarted -- both fixed as narrow, mechanical robustness/round-trip corrections (a numeric-comparison fix and restoring the missing crypt()-salt gating already used verbatim by this same placeholder's real implementation in sibling lib hell) without inventing any of the archive's own missing city/skill content. With both fixes and the inherit/room/room.lpc make_inventory() catch()-and-guard hardening (the room-population equivalent of this collection's established §7.25 pattern) in place, a brand-new character registers end-to-end with a real Chinese name all the way into the actual game world ("世外桃源", the same Peach-Blossom-Land entry room already documented for the wider yh2003/ES2 family), and correctly survives a full driver restart and reconnect.
